title: Tag-group and quick-note management scope; admins can't reach personal data
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a user, on the build under test. The Notifications Center feature is on.
  2. A personal tag group and a public tag group; a quick note; sign in as owner, as an admin, and as a non-owner.
custom_steps:
1. Confirm only the owner manages a personal tag group; the owner or any admin manages a public tag group.
  2. Confirm only the owner manages a quick note.
  3. As an admin, try to reach another user's personal tag groups, quick notes or preferences.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Only a tag group's owner can manage a personal tag group; a public tag group can be managed by its owner and any admin. Only a quick note's owner can manage that quick note.
  • An admin has no access to another user's personal tag groups, quick notes or preferences.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667; story SV-10253 (S10, Permissions); Notifications Update v1 PRD (Confluence 817463297), S10; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S10-R6: “Only a tag group's owner can manage a personal tag group.”
  • S10-R7: “A tag group's owner and any admin can manage a public tag group.”
  • S10-R8: “Only a quick note's owner can manage that quick note.”
  • S10-N2: “An admin has no access to another user's personal tag groups, quick notes or preferences.”

AUTOMATION: HOLD - authored from the PRD (Confluence 817463297) and the design canvas; not yet build-verified against a Notifications QA build (no QA branch yet)
